title: Committee of Supply − Head L (Ministry of the Environment and Water Resources)
what_it_is: Committee of Supply − Head L (Ministry of the Environment and Water Resources)

sections.label: IEA global energy intensity progress
sections.summary: The IEA reported global energy intensity improved 1.8% in 2015, but said progress remains too slow for a decarbonised energy system.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: According to the International Energy Agency (IEA), the global energy intensity − the amount of energy used per unit of gross domestic product (GDP) − improved by 1.8% in 2015.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: This surpassed the 1.5% gain seen in 2014 and triples the annual rate of 0.6% seen in the previous decade, according to the IEA Energy Efficiency Market Report for 2016.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: But the report added that and I quote: "However, global progress on energy intensity is still too slow, falling short of putting the world onto a sustainable pathway toward a decarbonised energy system.

sections.label: Cities banning diesel vehicles
sections.summary: In December 2016, four of the world's largest and most polluted cities decided to ban diesel cars and trucks by 2025.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: In December 2016, four of the world's largest and most polluted cities have decided to ban diesel cars and trucks from their streets by 2025.

sections.label: WHO outdoor air pollution deaths
sections.summary: According to WHO, seven million deaths every year are linked to exposure to outdoor air pollution.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: According to WHO, seven million deaths every year are linked to exposure to outdoor air pollution.

sections.label: Transportation carbon emissions share
sections.summary: About 19% of carbon emission comes from transportation.

sentences.speaker: Ms K Thanaletchimi (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: About 19% of carbon emission comes from transportation.

sections.label: Meat consumption and food emissions
sections.summary: Following health guidelines on meat consumption could cut global food-related emissions by nearly a third by 2050, and vegetarian diets by 63%.

sentences.speaker: Ms K Thanaletchimi (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: Adhering to health guidelines on meat consumption could cut global food-related emissions by nearly a third by 2050, while widespread adoption of a vegetarian diet would bring down emissions by 63%.

sections.label: Aedes aegypti Gravitrap detection increase
sections.summary: The agency detected 60% more Aedes aegypti mosquitoes the previous month over last October in its Gravitrap surveillance system.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Thiam Poh (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: The agency had detected 60% more Aedes aegypti mosquitoes the previous month over last October in its Gravitrap surveillance system.

sections.label: Dengue vaccine availability and effectiveness
sections.summary: Dengvaxia is commercially available here but is less effective against Den 1 and Den 2, though it reduces severe dengue by 84%.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Thiam Poh (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: Although the world's first dengue vaccine, Dengvaxia, is now commercially available here, it is much less effective against two of our most common strains, Den 1 and Den 2.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Thiam Poh (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: Nonetheless, since the vaccine reduces severe dengue by 84%, I hope that the Ministry will help publicise the availability of this vaccine to increase awareness.

sections.label: Air quality targets not met
sections.summary: Singapore is not on track to meet its 2020 air quality targets, having missed targets for PM2.5, PM10 and ozone for two years.

sentences.speaker: Dr Chia Shi-Lu (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: Unfortunately, we are not on track to achieve our air quality targets by 2020.

sentences.speaker: Dr Chia Shi-Lu (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: For the last two years, we have not been able to meet our targets for pollutants, such as fine particulate matter (PM2.5), particulate matter (PM10) and ozone.

sections.label: Diesel commercial vehicles and pollution
sections.summary: Diesel-driven commercial vehicles like vans and lorries make up about 30% of vehicles but nearly 60% of vehicle pollution.

sentences.speaker: Dr Chia Shi-Lu (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: Commercial vehicles, such as vans and lorries, are mostly diesel-driven and account for nearly 60% of our total pollution from vehicles although they make up only about 30% of vehicles on the roads.

sections.label: Diesel bans and commuter pollution exposure
sections.summary: Paris, Mexico City, Madrid and Athens will ban all diesel vehicles by 2025, and research showed a two-way bus journey five days a week can mean inhaling about 3.5 times more tiny pollutant particles than at ambient level.

sentences.speaker: Dr Chia Shi-Lu (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: For example, to improve air quality, Paris, Mexico City, Madrid and Athens have recently announced that they will ban the use of all diesel vehicles by 2025.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Daniel Goh Pei Siong (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: His research showed that a two-way bus journey five days a week could lead to a commuter inhaling about 3.5 times more tiny pollutant particles than at ambient level.

sections.label: Linggiu water level drop
sections.summary: The entitlement draw of 250 mgd from Linggiu meets over 60% of current demand of 430 mgd, and its water level dropped from 84% to 20% last October.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Thiam Poh
sentences.text: Our entitlement draw of 250 million gallons per day (mgd) of water from Linggiu meets over 60% of our current demand for 430 mgd of water.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Thiam Poh
sentences.text: Hence, the drastic drop in its water level over the past few years, from 84% to the lowest recorded level of 20% last October, is a matter of grave concern.

sections.label: Water demand rise and agreement expiry
sections.summary: Water demand is expected to rise to 800 mgd by 2061, the same year the 99-year water agreement with Malaysia expires.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Thiam Poh
sentences.text: Our demand for water is expected to rise to 800 mgd by 2061 as a result of growing population, commercial and industrial needs.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Thiam Poh
sentences.text: In the same year, our 99-year water agreement with Malaysia will expire.

sections.label: Household water conservation role
sections.summary: Households play an important role in water conservation as they account for 45% of water demand.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Thiam Poh
sentences.text: Our individual households play an important role in water conservation as they account for 45% of the water demand.

sections.label: Water price increase
sections.summary: Water price will increase for the first time in 17 years, by 15% in July this year and another 15% next July.

sentences.speaker: Dr Chia Shi-Lu
sentences.text: For the first time in 17 years, our water price will increase, with the first 15% in July this year and another 15% in July next year.

sections.label: Subsidies for HDB households
sections.summary: After subsidies, 1-room and 2-room flat households will hardly see bill increases, and 75% of HDB households can expect less than a $12 monthly increment.

sentences.speaker: Dr Chia Shi-Lu
sentences.text: After subsidies, households in 1-room and 2-room flats will hardly see any increase in their bills, and 75% of our HDB households can expect less than a $12 increment in their bills per month.

sections.label: Resuming new hawker centres
sections.summary: The Government announced resuming building of new hawker centres in 2011, totalling 20 centres by 2027.

sentences.speaker: Mr Liang Eng Hwa (Holland-Bukit Timah)
sentences.text: This is why, like many Members here in this House, I have always pushed for more hawker centres in Parliament as well as during my engagements with the Ministers and Ministries during GPC meetings.

sentences.speaker: Mr Liang Eng Hwa (Holland-Bukit Timah)
sentences.text: Hence, it was with great joy and satisfaction for me personally when the Government finally announced to resume the building of new hawker centres in 2011, and, in total, 20 centres by 2027, which I thought is not an ambitious timeline.

sections.label: Promoting hawker centre facility
sections.summary: Without sustained effort to promote this facility, which costs an average of $11,000 per hawker centre, it will not be money well spent.

sentences.speaker: Mr Png Eng Huat (Hougang)
sentences.text: Without a sustained effort to promote this facility, which costs an average of $11,000 per hawker centre, it will not be money well spent.

sections.label: NTUC Foodfare managing hawker centres
sections.summary: NTUC Foodfare is appointed to manage a pilot group of two new hawker centres and five existing hawker centres.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Daniel Goh Pei Siong
sentences.text: The second component is the appointment of NTUC Foodfare to manage what NEA calls a "pilot group" of two new hawker centres in Woodlands and Pasir Ris, and five existing hawker centres in Toa Payoh, Old Airport Road, Whampoa and Chong Pang.

sections.label: Littering tickets and Corrective Work Orders
sections.summary: NEA issued 31,000 littering tickets last year, up 18%, and the question asks how many repeat offenders received Corrective Work Orders in three years.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Thiam Poh
sentences.text: Littering tickets issued by NEA rose 18% last year to reach 31,000 tickets.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Thiam Poh
sentences.text: Would the Ministry share how many repeat offenders were issued Corrective Work Orders (CWOs) in the last three years and does it think that they have been effective?

sections.label: Mobile surveillance cameras for residents
sections.summary: The Ministry has been deploying mobile surveillance cameras to catch such residents in the act.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Thiam Poh
sentences.text: The Ministry has been deploying mobile surveillance cameras to catch such residents in the act.

sections.label: Singapore e-waste production ranking
sections.summary: Singapore is currently the second largest producer of e-waste per person in Asia.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
sentences.text: Singapore is currently the second largest producer of e-waste per person in Asia.

sections.label: Annual e-waste generated in Singapore
sections.summary: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources has explained in recent Parliamentary Question responses that 60,000 tonnes of e-waste are generated annually in Singapore.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Randolph Tan (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: As the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources has explained in his responses to some Parliamentary Questions over the last few months, 60,000 tonnes of e-waste are generated annually in Singapore.

sections.label: Stagnant domestic recycling rates
sections.summary: Domestic recycling rates in Singapore seem to have stagnated at around 19%-20% for many years.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: The domestic recycling rates in Singapore seem to have stagnated at around 19%-20% for many years.

sections.label: Recycling target and food waste
sections.summary: The question asks the Ministry's plan to raise domestic recycling rates to 30% by 2030, noting 785,500 tonnes of food waste were generated in 2015.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: What is the Ministry's plan to improve domestic recycling rates to 30% by 2030 under the Sustainable Singapore Blueprint?

sentences.speaker: Mr Liang Eng Hwa
sentences.text: As I understand from the Ministry, in 2015, an estimated 785,500 tonnes of food waste were generated, a 40% increase from the amount generated in 2005.

sections.label: Clementi food waste collection project
sections.summary: The Ministry announced a project to collect food waste from premises in Clementi for treatment at a centralised facility.

sentences.speaker: Mr Liang Eng Hwa
sentences.text: Last year, the Ministry announced a project to collect food waste from various premises in Clementi for treatment at a centralised facility.

sections.label: Hub food waste generation
sections.summary: The hub generates about 10 tonnes of food waste every month.

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheng Li Hui
sentences.text: Every month, the hub generates about 10 tonnes of food waste.

sections.label: Plan and SSB targets progress
sections.summary: The plan pursues a Liveable and Endearing Home, Vibrant and Sustainable City, and Active and Gracious Community, with progress in 2016 and SSB targets on track by 2030.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: This plan brings together all that we are doing, in pursuit of a Liveable and Endearing Home, a Vibrant and Sustainable City, and an Active and Gracious Community.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: I am glad to say that we have made progress over the course of 2016 and remain on track to meet the SSB targets progressively by 2030.

sections.label: 2016 hottest year recorded
sections.summary: The Meteorological Service recorded 2016 as the hottest year since 1929, when temperature records began.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: Our Meteorological Service recorded 2016 as the hottest year since 1929, when we started keeping temperature records.

sections.label: Paris Agreement pledge and carbon tax
sections.summary: Singapore is committed to its Paris Agreement pledge; industry contributes 60% of emissions, and a carbon tax on large emitters will send a price signal.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: As a responsible member of the international community, Singapore is committed to fulfilling our pledge under the Paris Agreement to reduce our greenhouse gas emissions.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: Industry, however, contributes the lion's share − 60% − of Singapore's greenhouse gas emissions.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: The upcoming carbon tax to be imposed on large emitters, as announced by the Minister for Finance, will help send the right price signal to industries to reduce their emissions when and where it makes the most business sense.

sections.label: Murata motor efficiency savings
sections.summary: Murata is replacing 50 motors with higher efficiency ones, saving about 160 MWh of electricity each year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: Murata is replacing 50 motors with higher efficiency ones.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: This will save Murata some 160 MWh of electricity each year.

sections.label: Energy Conservation Act amendments
sections.summary: The Energy Conservation Act will be amended to introduce initiatives helping companies improve energy efficiency, after studying feedback.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: Some also asked for best practices and useful data to be shared with them.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: We are studying their feedback and, for a start, we will amend the Energy Conservation Act to introduce a new set of initiatives to help companies improve their energy efficiency.

sections.label: Minimum Energy Performance Standards
sections.summary: Minimum Energy Performance Standards will be introduced for motors first, then other systems and equipment progressively, as NEA data shows much industrial equipment is inefficient.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: Third, NEA's data shows that a substantial proportion of common industrial equipment is inefficient.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: Hence, Minimum Energy Performance Standards will be introduced, first, for motors, and then other systems and equipment progressively.

sections.label: E2F redesign and SME co-funding
sections.summary: NEA will redesign the E2F to support energy efficiency retrofits, co-funding up to 30% of SME investments in energy-efficient technologies.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: NEA will redesign the E2F to better support companies to identify and undertake energy efficiency retrofits.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: We will, especially, help our SMEs by co-funding up to 30% of their investments in energy-efficient technologies.

sections.label: Revised CEVS becomes VES
sections.summary: CEVS will be revised to include tailpipe emissions of harmful air pollutants and renamed the Vehicular Emissions Scheme, with rebate or surcharge set by the worst performing pollutant.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: This remains important as vehicles contribute the second largest share of Singapore's greenhouse gas emissions, after industries.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: However, we now need to revise CEVS to include tailpipe emissions of harmful air pollutants, on top of carbon dioxide.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: The revised CEVS will be renamed as the Vehicular Emissions Scheme (VES).

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: To incentivise the purchase of car and taxi models which are more environmentally friendly overall, the VES rebate or surcharge will be determined by the worst performing pollutant.

sections.label: New standards effective April 2018
sections.summary: The new standards take effect on 1 April 2018 and will help minimise excessive emissions from vehicle defects or poor maintenance.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: The new standards will take effect on 1 April 2018 and will help minimise excessive emissions due to vehicle defects or poor maintenance.

sections.label: Higher COE bonus for LGVs
sections.summary: The scheme will be enhanced by increasing the COE bonus for Light Goods Vehicles from 13% to 35%, given industry feedback and their diesel pollution.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: Given industry feedback, as well as the findings that Light Goods Vehicles (LGVs) remain a major contributor of diesel pollution due to their large population, the scheme will also be enhanced by increasing the COE bonus for LGVs from 13% to 35%.

sections.label: Water Master Plan developments
sections.summary: PUB's Water Master Plan provides for NEWater and desalination plants to meet up to 85% of water demand by 2060, with new plants and DTSS Phase 2 underway.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: Last year, PUB completed its latest review of the Water Master Plan, a strategic blueprint for our water till 2060.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: The plan provides for development of NEWater and desalination plants to meet up to 85% of our water demand by 2060, as well as new pipelines for drinking water and used water.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: Singapore's fifth NEWater plant, located at Changi, officially opened in January this year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: The third desalination plant in Tuas will be completed this year, and the fourth and fifth desalination plants in Marina East and Jurong Island are underway.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: Phase 2 of the Deep Tunnel Sewerage System (DTSS), which includes the new water reclamation plant at Tuas, is on track for completion by 2025.

sections.label: Water efficiency standards and projects
sections.summary: PUB will raise minimum standards to two-tick for water fittings from April 2019, extend labelling to dishwashers, and run water-saving projects.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: As part of our plans to phase out less water-efficient products, PUB will raise the minimum standards to two-tick rating for the sale, supply and installation of water fittings from April 2019.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: PUB will also extend labelling requirements to dishwashers from October 2018.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: First, PUB will roll out a community project for lower income households to replace their existing nine-litre water closets with more efficient ones.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: Second, PUB will be installing smart shower devices for 10,000 new homes as a demonstration project.

sections.label: Stamford and Bukit Timah canals
sections.summary: The Stamford Detention Tank will be ready this year, while the Stamford Diversion Canal and Bukit Timah First Diversion Canal will be completed in 2018.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: The Stamford Detention Tank will be ready this year, while the Stamford Diversion Canal and the Bukit Timah First Diversion Canal will be completed in 2018.

sections.label: Annual e-waste generated
sections.summary: About 60,000 tonnes of e-waste are generated annually, as highlighted by Assoc Prof Randolph Tan and Mr Louis Ng.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: As Assoc Prof Randolph Tan and Mr Louis Ng have highlighted, about 60,000 tonnes of e-waste are generated annually.

sections.label: E-waste recycling and management system
sections.summary: Collected e-waste is sent to recyclers like Tes-Amm to extract resources, and industry stakeholders are being consulted on an enhanced national e-waste management system.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: The e-waste collected is sent to recyclers, such as Tes-Amm, where resources, such as copper, aluminium and gold are extracted for reuse.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: We are currently consulting industry stakeholders on an enhanced national e-waste management system, which would cover both the collection and disposal of e-waste.

sections.label: Packaging waste reduction efforts
sections.summary: The voluntary Singapore Packaging Agreement has cut over 32,000 tonnes of packaging waste since 2007, and possible regulations are being explored.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Since the launch of our voluntary Singapore Packaging Agreement in 2007, we have achieved a cumulative reduction of more than 32,000 tonnes of packaging waste, but more can be done.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: We are exploring possible regulations for businesses, such as mandatory reporting of packaging placed on the local market and the submission of packaging waste reduction plans, over the next two to four years.

sections.label: Dual refuse chutes requirement
sections.summary: New non-landed private residential developments taller than four storeys must install dual chutes for refuse and recyclables from 1 April 2018.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Buildings taller than four storeys in all new non-landed private residential developments will be required to install dual chutes for refuse and recyclables.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: This measure will apply to all new non-landed residential development applications submitted from 1 April 2018.

sections.label: PWCS for large developments
sections.summary: New non-landed private residential developments with at least 500 dwelling units must install PWCS from 1 April 2018.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: To date, more than 100 condominium developments, such as the Palette at Pasir Ris and Sky Habitat at Bishan, have installed the PWCS.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Therefore, to improve the efficiency and hygiene of waste collection, all new non-landed private residential developments with at least 500 dwelling units will need to be installed with PWCS.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: This measure will apply to all new non-landed residential development applications submitted from 1 April 2018.

sections.label: Litterbug tickets issued
sections.summary: NEA issued more than 31,000 tickets to litterbugs last year, almost 18% more than 2015 and the highest since 2009.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: NEA issued more than 31,000 tickets to litterbugs last year.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: This is almost 18% more than 2015 and the highest since 2009.

sections.label: Surveillance cameras against high-rise litterbugs
sections.summary: NEA has made more than 4,100 surveillance camera deployments and taken more than 3,300 enforcement actions against high-rise litterbugs since August 2012.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: NEA adopted the use of surveillance cameras in August 2012 and has since made more than 4,100 deployments and taken more than 3,300 enforcement actions against high-rise litterbugs.

sections.label: Expanded hawker centre pilot
sections.summary: NFC will manage five existing hawker centres and two new centres, with tenders called for the Yishun and Jurong West centres.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Given the encouraging outcomes of these initial efforts, we have extended this approach to other hawker centres.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: We have appointed NFC to manage a group of five existing centres with incumbent stallholders and two new centres.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: This is the first expanded pilot and we would need to evaluate the results of this approach before we decide on the next steps.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: We are calling for tenders for the two new centres in Yishun and Jurong West.

sections.label: Hawker Centre 3.0 recommendations accepted
sections.summary: The Ministry has accepted all the recommendations of the Hawker Centre 3.0 Committee.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Mr Liang asked about the response to the Hawker Centre 3.0 Committee's recommendations.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: I am pleased to announce that the Ministry has accepted all the recommendations.

sections.label: Hawker incubation stall programme
sections.summary: NEA will pre-fit hawker stalls at several hawker centres so eligible aspiring hawkers can try being a hawker for about six months.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: During the second half of the year, we will also be launching an incubation stall programme, where some hawker stalls at several hawker centres will be pre-fitted by NEA to let eligible aspiring hawkers try out being a hawker for a period of, say, six months.

sections.label: Hawker productivity funding and grants
sections.summary: Government sets aside $90 million for productivity initiatives, reconfiguring up to 25 centres, co-funding operating costs and a Hawkers' Productivity Grant.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: The Government will set aside $90 million to facilitate the adoption of productivity initiatives, which will help lighten the workload of hawkers and address manpower constraints.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: (In English): We recognise that hawkers are concerned about the cost of productivity initiatives.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Hence, as noted earlier, to alleviate these cost concerns, the Government will set aside about $90 million to facilitate the adoption of productivity initiatives in hawker centres.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: The funding will support the progressive reconfiguration of up to 25 existing centres over the next few years to facilitate the rolling out of centre-level productivity initiatives, such as centralised dishwashing integrated with tray return, and cashless payment solutions similar to those seen at the hawker centre in Our Tampines Hub or Ci Yuan Hawker Centre.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: We will also co-fund up to 70% of the operating cost of such initiatives for hawkers in these centres for a period of time.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: To promote stall-level productivity, we will set up a Hawkers' Productivity Grant to co-fund the purchase of suitable kitchen automation equipment for cooked food stallholders.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Each stallholder can claim 80% of the qualifying cost of the equipment on a reimbursement basis, up to a total of $5,000 within three years.

sections.label: Replacing water fittings in rental flats
sections.summary: PUB will replace nine-litre systems with four-litre ones in 1- and 2-room rental flats not qualifying for HIP, and study new shower devices.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: For the first question, PUB will be replacing those 1- and 2-room households, rental flats which do not qualify under the HIP at the moment, to accelerate the change of their systems from the nine-litre ones to the more water-saving four-litre ones.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: For those who are already undergoing HIP, there is a programme for them, in time, to be replaced.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: For the second question on the water volume devices used for the shower fixtures, these are still new and we want to see how consumers would behave and study them.

sections.label: Incentive not car ownership subsidy
sections.summary: The measure is not meant to subsidise or make car ownership cheaper but to incentivise, with $20,000 thought enough for right choices.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: It is not meant to subsidise or make ownership of cars cheaper.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: It is meant to incentivise and we think $20,000 will be enough for them to make the right choices.

sections.label: Mandatory PWCS for large developments
sections.summary: Private non-landed residential developments with 500 units or more will be required to have PWCS.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: What we are doing is to make it mandatory for private non-landed residential developments with 500 units or more to have PWCS.

sections.label: Withdrawal of amendment and sitting suspended
sections.summary: Dr Lee Bee Wah is asked to withdraw her amendment, and the Sitting is suspended until 4.50 pm.

sentences.speaker: The Chairman
sentences.text: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah, please withdraw your amendment.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah
sentences.text: I am sure, together, we will have a liveable and sustainable Singapore.

sentences.speaker: The Chairman
sentences.text: Thereupon Mdm Speaker left the Chair of the Committee and took the Chair of the House.

sentences.speaker: Mdm Speaker
sentences.text: I suspend the Sitting and will take the Chair at 4.50 pm.
